library_construction_protocol: Total RNA was extracted with the Ribo Pure™-Yeast kit (Ambion) following the manufacturer's instructions. The quality was assessed by capillary electrophoresis in a Bioanalyzer equipment and RNA amounts quantified by measuring the A260 in a Nanodrop ND-1000 Spectrophotometer. mRNA was purified from total RNA using poly-T oligo-attached magnetic beads. After fragmentation, the first strand cDNA was synthesized using random hexamer primers, followed by the second strand cDNA synthesis using dTTP (non-directional library). The library was checked by Qubit™ assay (Thermofisher) and real-time PCR for quantification and size distribution monitored with a Bioanalyzer.

description: Illumina NovaSeq 6000 sequencing: GSM7022091: Glucose, T=0 (pH 5.5), rep 2 [S23] Komagataella phaffii RNA-Seq
library_construction_protocol: Total RNA was extracted with the Ribo Pure™-Yeast kit (Ambion) following the manufacturer's instructions. The quality was assessed by capillary electrophoresis in a Bioanalyzer equipment and RNA amounts quantified by measuring the A260 in a Nanodrop ND-1000 Spectrophotometer. mRNA was purified from total RNA using poly-T oligo-attached magnetic beads. After fragmentation, the first strand cDNA was synthesized using random hexamer primers, followed by the second strand cDNA synthesis using dTTP (non-directional library). The library was checked by Qubit™ assay (Thermofisher) and real-time PCR for quantification and size distribution monitored with a Bioanalyzer.

description: Illumina NovaSeq X sequencing: GSM8984410: rim101 strain T=60 min (pH 8.0), replicate 2 Komagataella phaffii RNA-Seq
library_construction_protocol: Total RNA was extracted with the Ribo Pure™-Yeast kit (Ambion) following the manufacturer's instructions. The quality was assessed by capillary electrophoresis in a Bioanalyzer equipment and RNA amounts quantified by measuring the A260 in a Nanodrop ND-1000 Spectrophotometer. mRNA was purified from total RNA using poly-T oligo-attached magnetic beads. After fragmentation, the first strand cDNA was synthesized using random hexamer primers, followed by the second strand cDNA synthesis using dTTP (non-directional library). The library was ready after end repair, A-tailing, adapter ligation, size selection, amplification, and purification, and was checked by Qubit™ assay (Thermofisher) and real-time PCR for quantification and size distribution monitored with a Bioanalyzer.

Experiment_title: Illumina HiSeq 2500 sequencing: GSM3004395: OE_1 Komagataella phaffii RNA-Seq
study_title: A single Gal4-like transcription factor activates the Crabtree effect in Komagataella phaffii
description: Illumina HiSeq 2500 sequencing: GSM3004395: OE_1 Komagataella phaffii RNA-Seq
library_construction_protocol: Pellets from the samples collected during the exponential growth phase were resuspended in 1 mL TRI Reagent (Sigma, USA). Cells were disrupted by glass beads using a ribolyser (MP Biomedicals, USA) for 40 sec at 5.5 ms-1. RNA was extracted by chloroform and precipitated with isopropanol. After washing twice with 75% ethanol, RNA was dissolved in nuclease-free water. After DNase treatment (Invitrogen, USA), concentration of RNA was measured by Nanodrop and quality of the samples was verified with the Agilent Bioanalyzer 2100 using the RNA 6000 Nano Assay kit (Agilent Technologies, California). RNASeq analysis was performed with poly(A)-enriched mRNAs at Vienna Biocenter Core Facilities GmbH (AT). cDNA libraries were constructed from these poly(A)-enriched mRNAs and sequenced by Illumina HiSeq v4.

Experiment_title: Illumina HiSeq 2500 sequencing: GSM4025615: Y48124-G13B Komagataella phaffii RNA-Seq
study_title: Comparative genome-scale analysis of Pichia pastoris variants informs selection of an optimal base strain [protein expression]
description: Illumina HiSeq 2500 sequencing: GSM4025615: Y48124-G13B Komagataella phaffii RNA-Seq
library_construction_protocol: Cells were first digested in digestion buffer (50 mM EDTA, 500 mM sorbitol, pH 7.4) supplemented with 0.1% (v/v) 2-Mercaptoethanol and Zymolyase (Zymo Research, Irvine, CA) for 25 min at 30°C and 100 rpm shaking. Lysis and RNA purification was then performed using the RNeasy kit (Qiagen, Cat #74104). RNA quality was analyzed to ensure RNA Quality Number >7. Protein-expressing strain RNA libraries were prepared using a 3' DGE method adapted from Soumillon, Cacchiarelli, & Semrau, 2014 and sequenced on an Illumina HiSeq2500 to generate paired reads of 17bp (read1) + 46bp (read2).

description: Illumina HiSeq 2500 sequencing: GSM4025630: Y48124-H13B Komagataella phaffii RNA-Seq
library_construction_protocol: Cells were first digested in digestion buffer (50 mM EDTA, 500 mM sorbitol, pH 7.4) supplemented with 0.1% (v/v) 2-Mercaptoethanol and Zymolyase (Zymo Research, Irvine, CA) for 25 min at 30°C and 100 rpm shaking. description: Illumina NovaSeq 6000 sequencing: GSM7022097: Glucose, T=60 (pH 8.0), rep 2 [S26] Komagataella phaffii RNA-Seq
library_construction_protocol: Total RNA was extracted with the Ribo Pure™-Yeast kit (Ambion) following the manufacturer's instructions. The quality was assessed by capillary electrophoresis in a Bioanalyzer equipment and RNA amounts quantified by measuring the A260 in a Nanodrop ND-1000 Spectrophotometer. mRNA was purified from total RNA using poly-T oligo-attached magnetic beads. After fragmentation, the first strand cDNA was synthesized using random hexamer primers, followed by the second strand cDNA synthesis using dTTP (non-directional library). The library was checked by Qubit™ assay (Thermofisher) and real-time PCR for quantification and size distribution monitored with a Bioanalyzer.

Experiment_title: Illumina NovaSeq X sequencing: GSM8984408: rim101 strain T=30 min (pH 8.0), replicate 2 Komagataella phaffii RNA-Seq
study_title: The contribution of the transcription factors Crz1 and Rim101 to the response to alkalinization in Komagataella phaffii
description: Illumina NovaSeq X sequencing: GSM8984408: rim101 strain T=30 min (pH 8.0), replicate 2 Komagataella phaffii RNA-Seq
library_construction_protocol: Total RNA was extracted with the Ribo Pure™-Yeast kit (Ambion) following the manufacturer's instructions. The quality was assessed by capillary electrophoresis in a Bioanalyzer equipment and RNA amounts quantified by measuring the A260 in a Nanodrop ND-1000 Spectrophotometer. mRNA was purified from total RNA using poly-T oligo-attached magnetic beads. After fragmentation, the first strand cDNA was synthesized using random hexamer primers, followed by the second strand cDNA synthesis using dTTP (non-directional library). The library was ready after end repair, A-tailing, adapter ligation, size selection, amplification, and purification, and was checked by Qubit™ assay (Thermofisher) and real-time PCR for quantification and size distribution monitored with a Bioanalyzer.

study_title: A single Gal4-like transcription factor activates the Crabtree effect in Komagataella phaffii
description: Illumina HiSeq 2500 sequencing: GSM3004393: Control_2 Komagataella phaffii RNA-Seq
library_construction_protocol: Pellets from the samples collected during the exponential growth phase were resuspended in 1 mL TRI Reagent (Sigma, USA). Cells were disrupted by glass beads using a ribolyser (MP Biomedicals, USA) for 40 sec at 5.5 ms-1. RNA was extracted by chloroform and precipitated with isopropanol. After washing twice with 75% ethanol, RNA was dissolved in nuclease-free water. After DNase treatment (Invitrogen, USA), concentration of RNA was measured by Nanodrop and quality of the samples was verified with the Agilent Bioanalyzer 2100 using the RNA 6000 Nano Assay kit (Agilent Technologies, California). RNASeq analysis was performed with poly(A)-enriched mRNAs at Vienna Biocenter Core Facilities GmbH (AT). cDNA libraries were constructed from these poly(A)-enriched mRNAs and sequenced by Illumina HiSeq v4.

description: Illumina NovaSeq 6000 sequencing: GSM7022096: Glucose, T=60 (pH 8.0), rep 1 [S22] Komagataella phaffii RNA-Seq
library_construction_protocol: Total RNA was extracted with the Ribo Pure™-Yeast kit (Ambion) following the manufacturer's instructions. The quality was assessed by capillary electrophoresis in a Bioanalyzer equipment and RNA amounts quantified by measuring the A260 in a Nanodrop ND-1000 Spectrophotometer. mRNA was purified from total RNA using poly-T oligo-attached magnetic beads. After fragmentation, the first strand cDNA was synthesized using random hexamer primers, followed by the second strand cDNA synthesis using dTTP (non-directional library). The library was checked by Qubit™ assay (Thermofisher) and real-time PCR for quantification and size distribution monitored with a Bioanalyzer.

Experiment_title: Illumina NovaSeq X sequencing: GSM8984409: rim101 strain T=60 min (pH 8.0), replicate 1 Komagataella phaffii RNA-Seq
study_title: The contribution of the transcription factors Crz1 and Rim101 to the response to alkalinization in Komagataella phaffii
description: Illumina NovaSeq X sequencing: GSM8984409: rim101 strain T=60 min (pH 8.0), replicate 1 Komagataella phaffii RNA-Seq
library_construction_protocol: Total RNA was extracted with the Ribo Pure™-Yeast kit (Ambion) following the manufacturer's instructions. The quality was assessed by capillary electrophoresis in a Bioanalyzer equipment and RNA amounts quantified by measuring the A260 in a Nanodrop ND-1000 Spectrophotometer. mRNA was purified from total RNA using poly-T oligo-attached magnetic beads. After fragmentation, the first strand cDNA was synthesized using random hexamer primers, followed by the second strand cDNA synthesis using dTTP (non-directional library). The library was ready after end repair, A-tailing, adapter ligation, size selection, amplification, and purification, and was checked by Qubit™ assay (Thermofisher) and real-time PCR for quantification and size distribution monitored with a Bioanalyzer.

Experiment_title: Illumina HiSeq 2500 sequencing: GSM3004392: Control_1 Komagataella phaffii RNA-Seq
study_title: A single Gal4-like transcription factor activates the Crabtree effect in Komagataella phaffii
description: Illumina HiSeq 2500 sequencing: GSM3004392: Control_1 Komagataella phaffii RNA-Seq
library_construction_protocol: Pellets from the samples collected during the exponential growth phase were resuspended in 1 mL TRI Reagent (Sigma, USA). Cells were disrupted by glass beads using a ribolyser (MP Biomedicals, USA) for 40 sec at 5.5 ms-1. RNA was extracted by chloroform and precipitated with isopropanol. After washing twice with 75% ethanol, RNA was dissolved in nuclease-free water. After DNase treatment (Invitrogen, USA), concentration of RNA was measured by Nanodrop and quality of the samples was verified with the Agilent Bioanalyzer 2100 using the RNA 6000 Nano Assay kit (Agilent Technologies, California). RNASeq analysis was performed with poly(A)-enriched mRNAs at Vienna Biocenter Core Facilities GmbH (AT). cDNA libraries were constructed from these poly(A)-enriched mRNAs and sequenced by Illumina HiSeq v4.

study_title: Comparative genome-scale analysis of Pichia pastoris variants informs selection of an optimal base strain [protein expression]
description: Illumina HiSeq 2500 sequencing: GSM4025614: Y48124-G13A Komagataella phaffii RNA-Seq
library_construction_protocol: Cells were first digested in digestion buffer (50 mM EDTA, 500 mM sorbitol, pH 7.4) supplemented with 0.1% (v/v) 2-Mercaptoethanol and Zymolyase (Zymo Research, Irvine, CA) for 25 min at 30°C and 100 rpm shaking. Lysis and RNA purification was then performed using the RNeasy kit (Qiagen, Cat #74104). RNA quality was analyzed to ensure RNA Quality Number >7. Protein-expressing strain RNA libraries were prepared using a 3' DGE method adapted from Soumillon, Cacchiarelli, & Semrau, 2014 and sequenced on an Illumina HiSeq2500 to generate paired reads of 17bp (read1) + 46bp (read2).

description: Illumina HiSeq 2500 sequencing: GSM4025631: Y48124-H13C Komagataella phaffii RNA-Seq
